CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scoring_text(p_value text, p_max integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select p_value is not null and p_value = btrim(p_value, E' \t\n\r\f\013')
  and char_length(p_value) between 1 and p_max $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scoring_source_url(p_value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select public.scoring_text(p_value,2048)
  and p_value ~ '^https?://[^/@?#[:space:]]+([/?#][^[:space:]]*)?$' $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.grade_cutoff_lookup(p_content_item_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) || jsonb_build_object(
  'academic_year',e.academic_year,'exam_month',e.exam_month,'institute','한국교육과정평가원',
  'subject_id',s.subject_id,'subject_label',s.raw_subject_label)
  order by s.display_order,r.elective_key,r.grade),'[]'::jsonb)
 from public.grade_cutoff_references r join public.exams e on e.content_item_id=r.content_item_id
 join public.exam_subjects s on s.id=r.exam_subject_id and s.is_active
 join public.content_items c on c.id=r.content_item_id and c.is_active
 where r.content_item_id=p_content_item_id and r.is_current and r.status='published' and r.verified_at is not null
 and e.grade_level=3 and e.exam_type in ('evaluation_mock','csat');
$function$

constraints.name: answer_key_versions_correction
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((corrected_at IS NULL) AND (correction_note IS NULL)) OR ((corrected_at IS NOT NULL) AND (correction_note IS NOT NULL) AND scoring_text(correction_note, 1000))))

constraints.name: answer_key_versions_parent
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (exam_subject_id, content_item_id) REFERENCES exam_subjects(id, content_item_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: answer_key_versions_points_source
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((points_source_name IS NULL) AND (points_source_url IS NULL) AND (points_source_digest IS NULL)) OR ((points_source_name IS NOT NULL) AND (points_source_url IS NOT NULL) AND (points_source_digest IS NOT NULL) AND scoring_text(points_source_name, 200) AND scoring_source_url(points_source_url) AND (points_source_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))

constraints.name: answer_key_versions_publication
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'draft'::text) AND (published_at IS NULL) AND (content_digest IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['published'::text, 'withdrawn'::text])) AND (verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (content_digest IS NOT NULL) AND (fetched_at <= verified_at) AND (verified_at <= published_at))))

constraints.name: exam_questions_answer_key_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (answer_key_version_id) REFERENCES answer_key_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: mock_exam_attempts_cutoff
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (grade_cutoff_version_id, exam_subject_id, paper_variant, max_score) REFERENCES grade_cutoff_versions(id, exam_subject_id, paper_variant, max_score) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: mock_exam_attempts_grade
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((grade IS NULL) AND (grade_status = 'unavailable'::text) AND (grade_cutoff_version_id IS NULL)) OR ((grade IS NOT NULL) AND (grade_status = ANY (ARRAY['estimated'::text, 'confirmed'::text])) AND (grade_cutoff_version_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: mock_exam_attempts_key
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (answer_key_version_id, exam_subject_id, paper_variant, max_score) REFERENCES answer_key_versions(id, exam_subject_id, paper_variant, max_score) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: mock_exam_attempts_study

constraints.name: mock_exam_attempts_user_id_fkey

constraints.name: mock_exam_answers_attempt

constraints.name: grade_cutoff_references_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((raw_score IS NULL) OR (raw_score_min IS NULL)))

constraints.name: grade_cutoff_references_check5

constraints.name: grade_cutoff_references_check6

view:
SELECT es.id AS exam_subject_id,
    k.paper_variant,
    k.id AS answer_key_version_id,
    k.version AS answer_key_version,
    k.content_digest,
    k.question_count,
    k.max_score,
        CASE
            WHEN k.id IS NULL THEN 'timer_only'::text
            ELSE 'scoring_available'::text
        END AS availability,
    g.id AS grade_cutoff_version_id,
    g.version AS grade_cutoff_version,
    COALESCE(g.certainty, 'unavailable'::text) AS grade_status,
    'mcq5-v1'::text AS scoring_version
   FROM exam_subjects es
     LEFT JOIN answer_key_versions k ON k.exam_subject_id = es.id AND k.is_current AND k.status = 'published'::text
     LEFT JOIN grade_cutoff_versions g ON g.exam_subject_id = k.exam_subject_id AND g.paper_variant = k.paper_variant AND g.max_score = k.max_score AND g.is_current AND g.status = 'published'::text;

account_dependencies.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION account_private.allowed(u uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select u is not null and exists(select 1 from auth.users where id=u) and not exists(select 1 from public.account_deletion_requests where subject_id=u and state in ('DELETION_PENDING','ERASING'))
$function$
